title: De-duplicate metrics.text/metrics.stats into shared util module

mutations.desc: if the shared util's normalize_token is weakened (drops the alphanumeric filter), old tests MUST fail -- proves both modules actually route through the shared util instead of keeping hidden duplicates

prompt: This workspace contains `metrics`, where `normalize_token` and `tokenize` are copy-pasted duplicates living in both `metrics/text.py` and `metrics/stats.py`. TASK: refactor so the single source of truth lives in a NEW module `metrics/util.py`; both `metrics/text.py` and `metrics/stats.py` must import the shared functions from it (relative `from .util import ...` or absolute `from metrics.util import ...`). HARD RULES: (1) behavior must be identical -- every existing test in `tests/test_text.py` and `tests/test_stats.py` must keep passing UNMODIFIED (do not edit/delete tests); (2) the public API must survive: `metrics.text.normalize_token`, `metrics.text.tokenize`, `metrics.stats.normalize_token`, `metrics.stats.tokenize`, `metrics.stats.count_frequency` all stay importable with identical behavior; (3) the duplicates must really go away -- after refactoring, the shared util must be the only implementation actually used. Verify with `python -m pytest` inside the workspace.
